intent: two design review boards; not integrated into app

prompts.wardrobe:
Use case: stylized-concept, identity-preserving character wardrobe design.
Asset type: a finished six-look wardrobe REVIEW SHEET for Luya, not a game UI and not a runtime sprite.
Reference roles: Image 1 is the ORIGINAL Luya face, body-proportion and fine painterly anime rendering reference. Image 2 is a closer face/eyes identity reference. Image 3 is approved current painterly life illustration style, neutral daylight and original face consistency. These are identity/style references only; do not reproduce their rooms or poses.
Create six full-body illustrations of THE SAME recognizable young adult college-student character Luya, in one beautifully clean portrait 3:4 design board with exactly 3 columns and 2 rows of equal cells. Only one Luya per cell. Maintain her soft original face geometry, brown eyes, chestnut-brown hair, natural wispy bangs and side strands, consistent skin tone and natural body proportions. Preserve the detailed delicate painterly anime style of the references, fine hair strands, believable fabric. Keep one SMALL deer hair clip in each look, no deer earrings/necklace or repeated deer motifs.
All six figures at comparable scale, eye-level camera, head-to-toe including all shoes/socks completely visible, generous room around heads and feet. Quiet warm off-white backdrop in every cell, gentle neutral daylight with minimal contact shadow, no scenes. Subtle thin pale dividers, balanced whitespace. Do not let a caption or a crop cover any part of a figure. No massive title, ornaments, logos or watermarks.
Cell order left to right top row then bottom row:
L01 熟悉日常: original ivory short cable-knit cardigan over dusty-rose plain top, light warm-gray high-waist straight-leg full-length trousers, simple cream canvas shoes. Original long loosely wavy hair worn down with the original bangs. Natural relaxed standing pose, small friendly closed-mouth smile.
L02 校园项目: pale-blue loose cotton button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, plain white T-shirt underneath, dark indigo straight jeans, clean sneakers, small plain understated backpack worn naturally. Relaxed LOW ponytail at nape, original wispy face-framing strands, soft wavy ends. Alert and lively expression, ordinary standing pose.
L03 城市散步: muted sage-green lightweight jacket over fine navy-and-cream striped T-shirt, beige straight full-length trousers, simple sneakers, small practical crossbody bag with believable strap. HIGH ponytail with softly wavy ends and original bangs. Curious relaxed expression, slight natural weight shift.
L04 阅读看展: dark coffee-brown fine-knit vest over oat-colored cotton shirt, smoke-blue A-line skirt extending well below knees, flat brown shoes. HALF-UP hairstyle, upper hair tied back and long soft waves retained below. Calm thoughtful expression, no book blocking clothes.
L05 居家专注: comfortable loose oat-colored cotton long-sleeve lounge top and pale gray-blue full-length lounge trousers, simple socks, no shoes. MESSY LOOSE BUN with familiar face-framing strands and original bangs. Soft relaxed expression, hands resting naturally by side, fully dressed ordinary homewear.
L06 暖季外出: cream-base below-knee light cotton dress with tiny sparse muted sage and dusty-rose floral print, thin short ivory cardigan, simple flat shoes, small natural canvas shoulder bag. One LOOSE SIDE BRAID over one shoulder with original bangs and soft face-framing strands. Gentle natural small smile.
Each look must have distinct clothing silhouette/materials, not just recoloring. Hairstyles must match all six descriptions without altering face identity. Fabric folds, hands, fingers, feet, bag straps anatomically coherent. No anime school uniform, cosplay, photorealistic person, glamour styling, erotic framing, oversized eyes replacing the original face, unrealistic body elongation, multiple heads, missing legs, cropped shoes, food, plush toys, or detailed backgrounds.
Text exactly beneath each cell: "L01 熟悉日常", "L02 校园项目", "L03 城市散步", "L04 阅读看展", "L05 居家专注", "L06 暖季外出". Use small clean dark-gray sans-serif labels. No other text.
Output one high-detail complete six-look review board; references' existing clothing and images must remain untouched.
prompts.hairstyles:
Use case: stylized-concept, identity-preserving hairstyle design.
Asset type: a finished six-hairstyle comparison REVIEW BOARD for the companion character Luya.
Input 1 original full portrait and input 2 original close-up are identity and rendering references. Input 3 current life illustration is supporting painterly style reference. Use these as references only. Create six bust/waist portraits of THE SAME Luya, not six different characters.
Layout: one wide landscape 3:2 sheet, exactly 3 columns and 2 rows, equal-size clean cells on warm light ivory background with pale thin dividing lines. Each portrait has plenty of space around all hair, scalp and shoulders. Show head, all styled hair ends needed to read the hairstyle, neck and shoulders to upper waist; do not cut top of head or chop ponytail/braid. Consistent portrait scale and gentle eye-level view, very slight 3/4 rotation to make the tied structures visible. Same understated closed-mouth smile and calm facial expression throughout, same plain ivory cotton crew-neck long-sleeve top, no bags/jewelry/props, same neutral soft daylight. No room/background scenery. Compare hair only.
Preserve original Luya: familiar delicate soft face geometry and feature spacing, warm brown eyes, chestnut-brown hair, natural wispy original bangs, same hairline and skin tone, finely detailed painterly anime rendering. All variants have one small deer hair clip subtly positioned near the temple, no duplicate deer motifs. This is the same character with the same long-hair length restyled. Hair color must remain identical in all cells, not become blond, red or black.
Order left to right first row then second row:
H01 披发: original long soft wavy hair worn fully down, original curtain-like wispy bangs; clear shoulder-length-to-waist waves.
H02 半扎发: upper half of hair gathered and tied visibly high at back of head with a small neutral tie; lower half remains visibly long and loose down both shoulders. Show an unmistakable tied half-up section plus flowing loose lower section, not merely ordinary loose hair.
H03 低马尾: all back hair gathered into ONE ponytail attached LOW at nape, draped over a shoulder so the base and long softly wavy ponytail are both visible; original wispy bangs and two small face strands, neck and sides more exposed. Clearly low tie point.
H04 高马尾: all back hair gathered into ONE ponytail attached HIGH at crown; raised tie point distinctly visible above ear level, long wavy tail sweeping to one side within its cell. Original bangs/face strands, clearly different silhouette from low ponytail.
H05 松丸子头: loose casually wound bun at back/crown with entire long hair gathered up, a believable soft voluminous bun fully visible above shoulders. Familiar wispy bangs and a few face-framing strands. No long loose ponytail.
H06 侧编发: one long loose THREE-STRAND braid draped over one shoulder, clearly readable interwoven braid texture and small plain tie at its end; familiar bangs and soft side strands. Do not draw two braids or ponytail.
Keep all six faces closely matched to references. Detailed naturally overlapping strands, believable hair attachment, original refined illustration feel; no simplified flat cel-shading, chibi, photorealistic face, exaggerated beauty makeup, animal ears/antlers, new haircut, crown, hair ornaments covering face, extra shoulders, duplicated necks or cut-off hair.
Small exact clean dark-gray sans-serif label centered beneath each portrait: "H01 披发", "H02 半扎发", "H03 低马尾", "H04 高马尾", "H05 松丸子头", "H06 侧编发". No other text or watermark.
Produce one high-detail complete six-hairstyle comparison board.
